name: Abyssal Echo
detailed_description:
"Abyssal Echo" is a Lovecraftian-inspired horror mystery game set in the crushing depths of the ocean. Players assume the role of a special operations technician, equipped with cutting-edge rescue technology, tasked with infiltrating an unexplored underwater facility to locate survivors. But beware—within the flickering shadows of this derelict base, not all who appear human are what they seem. Sinister, otherworldly creatures lurk in the darkness, masquerading as survivors while plotting their next move.

Navigate the sprawling facility to uncover cryptic clues, rescue survivors barely clinging to life, and retrieve classified data critical to humanity's survival all while evading unspeakable horrors. Every decision could mean the difference between salvation and a fate worse than death. Trust your instincts, master your tools, and ensure your own survival in this chilling blend of spine-chilling suspense and cerebral challenges.

[Core Gameplay]
At its heart, Abyssal Echo revolves around high-stakes search-and-rescue operations. Players adopt a top-down perspective to navigate procedurally generated levels, locating survivors and guiding them to evacuation zones. The path to safety is fraught with peril: enemies disguised as humans, flooding corridors, malfunctioning security systems, and pitch-black zones drained of power. Strategic planning is paramount—players must prioritize routes, manage risks, and make split-second decisions to maximize survivor survival rates. One wrong move could doom both the rescued and the rescuer.

[Visual Style]
The game embraces a retro CRT aesthetic, emulating the gritty, distorted visuals of vintage monitors. Rather than embodying a frontline rescuer, players remotely pilot advanced equipment from a control station, viewing the harrowing rescue scenes through a layered interface of flickering screens, static-heavy feeds, and diegetic UI elements. This unique presentation—bolstered by analog-inspired sound design, chromatic aberration, and scanline effects—immerses players in a tense, technologically constrained world where every glitch could hide a lurking threat.

[Narrative Hook]
Forget clichéd deep-sea labs mining resources or testing weapons—Abyssal Echo subverts expectations with a bizarre yet haunting premise: a secret underwater facility designed for experimental agriculture. Why cultivate crops in the abyss? What catastrophic accident transformed this botanical haven into a nightmare of mutated life and cosmic horror? As players uncover encrypted logs and survivor testimonies, they’ll unravel a story blending existential dread, ecological hubris, and the chilling consequences of humanity’s arrogance. The truth, buried deeper than the ocean floor, awaits those brave enough to confront it.

Will you unravel the mysteries of the deep... or become another victim claimed by the abyss?
